title: Scribe: merge learnings into unified notes + type-aware auto-archive
problem: Scribe maintains two parallel stores (notes and learnings) with duplicated CRUD code. The duplication is pure maintenance cost and learnings lack features available to notes (done, update, archive).
description: 1. Add 'learning' to VALID_TYPES and TYPE_FOLDERS in scribe/store.py (folder name 'learnings', already exists). 2. Delete add_learning/get_learning/list_learnings/unlearn_learning from store.py. 3. Update all callers in notes.py (cmd_learn, cmd_learnings, cmd_unlearn, cmd_get learning branch) and core/startup.py (learning count) to use unified note paths with note_type='learning'. Keep 'learn' as a thin alias for 'add --type learning'. 4. Add NEVER_ARCHIVE = {'learning'} in notes.py. Update _run_auto_archive_store to skip types in that set. The handoff 'keep only latest per (role, mission)' rule must NOT change. 5. CRITICAL: Three other test files import LEARNING_FOLDER from store.py and WILL break when it is removed: scribe/test_store.py, scribe/test_backup_indexes.py, and scribe/test_repair.py. Update ALL imports in these files to use TYPE_FOLDERS['learning'] instead of the removed LEARNING_FOLDER constant. Also update scribe/test_store.py to remove any references to NEXT_ID_FILENAME if the global counter is removed. 6. CRITICAL: Update ALL existing learning tests in scribe/test_notes.py (test_learn_creates_entry, test_list_learnings, test_list_learnings_search, test_unlearn_removes_entry) to use the unified note API instead of the deleted store methods. These tests call store.add_learning/list_learnings/unlearn_learning directly and WILL break if not updated. 7. Run the FULL scribe test suite (python -m unittest discover -s scribe -p 'test_*.py') and fix ALL regressions before completing. There are 4 test files total that must pass: test_notes.py, test_store.py, test_backup_indexes.py, test_repair.py.
scope: Modified: scribe/store.py, scribe/notes.py, core/startup.py, scribe/test_notes.py, scribe/test_store.py, scribe/test_backup_indexes.py, scribe/test_repair.py
